cost_scope: Recorded agent sessions measure UI draft entry only; research, preparation, inference and musical validation are excluded. No total correction-cost estimate.
limits: Scores are uncalibrated cosine compatibility, not confidence or accuracy.
No chord order, section boundaries, physical change timings or strumming are inferred.
Pitch-class matches cannot prove octave, guitar voicing, tuning or physical capo position.
NNLS uses global tuning compensation; no cents or concert-pitch result is claimed.
Source palettes may omit real contrasting material; vocals/bass/harmonics can affect full-mix chroma.
No shift is used to relabel raw charts or approve an arrangement.
other is a residual mixture, not an isolated guitar stem
G/Gm cue timestamps are exposed BTC predictions, not physical chord boundaries
No accuracy, causal vocal-contamination or improved transcription conclusion follows from template scores
Scores use full-mix/source estimates, not a performed chord reference.
Matched-support scores exclude inactive/zero evidence in either condition; report coverage separately.
Research outputs do not replace the original learner audio or charts.
